candidate.name: bm25-document-diverse
candidate.description: Fetch the top 100 BM25 chunks, retain only the highest-ranked chunk from each source document, and return the first 10 distinct documents.

hypothesis: Multi-hop coverage is limited partly by duplicate chunks from the same document consuming the top-10 window.
decision_rule: Advance only if the candidate improves full-evidence coverage on the untouched confirmation slice and does not regress any guardrail metric; then report the fixed candidate on all answerable public queries without further tuning.
forbidden_after_preregistration: allowing more than one chunk per document
